purpose: Declare one test per AC of US-19004 (FBS-224) driving rcf guidance, rcf build bundle --next --format md and rcf doctor through bin/rcf.js, so the FBS-224 Define round turns each declaration into a red test against the shipped stage contract text.
title: Guidance, managed agent-instructions block, bundle runbook and README state the five-stage hand contract, Finalise by --ci-run from a Test-stage report, audit as the fifth verb, and doctor flags the old block

testCases.description: rcf guidance build-cycle exits 0 and its Test stage names the verifier hand, rcf verify run --fbs <fbs-id> --hand verifier and rcf/verify-reports/, its Finalise stage names rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref>, with no "--url <deploy-url>" and no "post-merge verify run"
testCases.testPointer: test/guidance/build-cycle-0-37.test.js::AC-20401-1: rcf guidance build-cycle carries the five stage headings in order, TEST running the full RCF suite locally with nothing deployed, FINALISE before the merge writing complete, and a VERIFY (outside the build cycle) section with rcf verify run --record writing verified

testCases.description: rcf guidance build-cycle exits 0 with the Define stage naming the test-author hand and TS/TC bindings, the Build stage naming the builder for production code, Code Nodes and code-hygiene unit tests only, and every stage naming its Hand: trailer
testCases.testPointer: test/guidance/build-cycle-0-37.test.js::AC-20401-1: rcf guidance build-cycle carries the five stage headings in order, TEST running the full RCF suite locally with nothing deployed, FINALISE before the merge writing complete, and a VERIFY (outside the build cycle) section with rcf verify run --record writing verified

testCases.description: rcf build bundle --next --format md closes with a runbook listing the five stages and hands, rcf verify run --hand verifier, rcf audit separation and rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref>, with no finalise --mode or --url
testCases.testPointer: test/guidance/build-cycle-0-37.test.js::AC-20401-4: the closing runbook of rcf build bundle FBS-001 --base-suite <green> --format md lists the five stages in order with dispatch names, commit prefixes and the round commands, ending with the Verify-outside-the-round line, and --format json carries the same in completionContract

testCases.description: rcf guidance managed/agent-instructions-block states verified is written only by rcf build finalise from a Test-stage report, the release notes carry a non-null minAgentAction, and rcf doctor reports the old block as drifted
testCases.testPointer: test/guidance/build-cycle-0-37.test.js::AC-20401-3: the managed block names the five stages with their prefixes, carries rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> writing complete before the merge, states that verified is written only by a release Verify, and its RULE 13 names merging before Finalise has written complete and not verified on the PR branch

testCases.description: the root README and every rcf guidance topic read define, build, verify, release, audit as the stage chain and never name attest as a verb or stage, leaving AC attestation and --litmus-attested as they are
testCases.testPointer: test/guidance/stage-contract.test.js::AC-19004-5: the root README and every rcf guidance topic read define, build, verify, release, audit as the stage chain and never name attest as a verb or stage, leaving AC attestation and --litmus-attested as they are

testCases.description: rcf doctor on a project whose CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md carries the pre-change managed block reports it drifted, names rcf doctor --fix and exits non-zero

testCases.description: no rcf guidance topic and no rcf build bundle --next runbook tells a hand to run rcf build finalise with --mode or --url, or to run verification after merge
